actual_scope: Prove a matching theta^(-1/2) lower order for broad Gaussian phase-cell inverses at beta_0=-1/2, using a positive checkerboard rectangle.

bottleneck_link: The Gaussian conditioning exponent affects precision budgets. A lower estimate distinguishes an unavoidable edge loss from slack in an upper proof; it does not price physical execution.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved matching-order lower estimate. Leave the sharp constant and complete physical caller open.
